title: The Verdant Conspiracy
tagline: A poisoned botanical reserve. Three botanists. One chemical trail.
atmosphere: Breezy afternoon in a nature preserve, rustling leaves, birdcalls.
premise: A rare stand of historic redwoods was contaminated with an illegal synthetic growth inhibitor. Field investigators must trace the culprit's footsteps along the park trail.

suspects.name: Dr. Helena Shaw
suspects.motive: Seeking to prove her patented biological antidote is the only savior for the forest.
suspects.alibi: Claims she was lecturing students in the park amphitheater.
suspects.hiddenTrait: Uses synthetic copper-sulfate blue dye markers on all test specimens.
suspects.eliminationClue: Beat 3 proves the chemical canister used an alkaline yellow indicator, not Helena's acidic blue tracer.

suspects.name: Marcus Kane
suspects.motive: If the grove dies, zoning permits clearing the parcel for luxury townhomes.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was surveying the northern highway overpass.
suspects.hiddenTrait: Carries concentrated glyphosate canisters sealed with bright yellow silicone caps.
suspects.eliminationClue: None — his yellow cap seals and surveyor stakes match the crime scene precisely.

suspects.name: Rowan Finch
suspects.motive: Furious that the park service sprayed mosquito foggers near his hives.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was tending hives near the south meadow creek.
suspects.hiddenTrait: Always leaves trails of natural unrefined pine smoke when working outdoors.
suspects.eliminationClue: Beat 2 proves no organic smoke residue was present, only industrial synthetic petroleum solvent.

beats.title: The Trail Marker
beats.prompt: Locate an outdoor trail marker, wooden post, or park boundary sign.
beats.fieldInstruction: Pocket your phone. Follow the walking trail until you spot a trail post or directional sign.

targetPredicate.name: Trail Marker Post
targetPredicate.safetyNotice: Only observe objects in open, public, accessible areas. Never trespass.

hintLevels.level1: Search along the walking path for an upright post guiding visitors.
hintLevels.level2: Look for a wooden signpost or trail distance marker.
hintLevels.level3: Inspect the base of a wooden trail stake where the path forks.

beats.narrativeRevelation: A fresh triangular notch was carved into the trail post to mount a high-precision surveyor prism.

beats.title: The Living Bark
beats.prompt: Locate a tree trunk, large branch, or living plant stalk.
beats.fieldInstruction: Put phone away. Walk 30 paces and locate a mature tree trunk.

targetPredicate.name: Tree Trunk Bark Surface
targetPredicate.safetyNotice: Only observe objects in open, public, accessible areas. Never trespass.

hintLevels.level1: Find a mature tree with deep furrowed bark.
hintLevels.level2: Look closely at the texture of tree bark about chest high.
hintLevels.level3: Check the trunk of a tree standing close to the path.

beats.narrativeRevelation: Chemical analysis reveals petroleum-based solvent spray, ruling out Rowan Finch's natural organic beekeeper smoke.

beats.title: The Color Anomaly
beats.prompt: Locate a distinct yellow or bright colored object/surface outdoors.
beats.fieldInstruction: Phone in pocket. Scan for a vivid yellow or high-contrast accent in your surroundings.

targetPredicate.name: Vivid Yellow Accent
targetPredicate.safetyNotice: Only observe objects in open, public, accessible areas. Never trespass.

hintLevels.level1: Scan the landscape for a pop of synthetic yellow color.
hintLevels.level2: Look for yellow warning paint, a plastic ribbon, or a safety marker.
hintLevels.level3: Check around ground level or fixtures for a yellow tag or plastic fitting.

beats.narrativeRevelation: A discarded yellow silicone cap matches the industrial sealant used by Marcus Kane. Helena Shaw's copper-blue dye marker is absent.

beats.title: The Weathered Ground Plate
beats.prompt: Locate a stone paving, curb, or metallic ground cover fixture.
beats.fieldInstruction: Final beat. Phone away and scan the ground for an engineered stone or metal fixture.

targetPredicate.name: Ground Plate / Stone Marker
targetPredicate.safetyNotice: Only observe objects in open, public, accessible areas. Never trespass.

hintLevels.level1: Look down at the pavement edge, curbstone, or ground marker.
hintLevels.level2: Search for flat stone masonry or an engineered paving border.
hintLevels.level3: Inspect where the pathway stone meets the grass.

beats.narrativeRevelation: Driven into the ground under the grass is a commercial subdivision surveyor stake registered to Marcus Kane's development firm.

solutionNarrative: Marcus Kane sabotaged the grove using industrial growth inhibitors so the protected environmental status would be revoked, enabling his development company to acquire the timberland for construction.
audioNarrationSummary: Marcus Kane's surveyor prism marks and yellow chemical caps exposed his sabotage scheme to clear protected woodland for commercial development.
